decisions.reason: The data processing agreement tool builds on the firm's documented compliance know-how and its agency focus, and early customer praise for the agency templates is a signal the firm can read and build on with its own R&D.

As the flagship platform on the home page, it extends the firm's owned infrastructure and integrated management tools, so it sits squarely within the firm's absorptive capacity and strategic direction.
The configurable managed hosting plan is a close extension of the core hosting offer on its containerized architecture, so the firm can easily interpret its results and refine it.
